package network

config interface 'loopback'
	option device 'lo'
	option proto 'static'
	list ipaddr '127.0.0.1/8'

config globals 'globals'
	option dhcp_default_duid '0004ae4557d234054b41adcaae3ee8da7e65'
	option ula_prefix 'fd06:b820:5389::/48'

config device
	option name 'br-lan'
	option type 'bridge'
	list ports 'lan1'
	list ports 'lan2'

config interface 'lan'
	option device 'br-lan'
	option proto 'static'
	list ipaddr '192.168.1.1/24'
	option ip6assign '60'

config interface 'wan'
	option device 'wan'
	option proto 'dhcp'

config interface 'wan6'
	option device 'wan'
	option proto 'dhcpv6'

config interface 'wwan'
	option proto 'dhcp'

config device 'guest_dev'
	option name 'br-guest'
	option type 'bridge'
	option bridge_empty '1'

config interface 'guest'
	option proto 'static'
	option device 'br-guest'
	option ipaddr '192.168.2.1/24'

config interface 'wg0'
	option proto 'wireguard'
	option disabled '1'
	option private_key 'REDACTED'
	list addresses '100.64.41.140/32'

config wireguard_wg0 'wg0_peer0'
	option endpoint_host '203.0.113.8'
	option endpoint_port '51820'
	option public_key 'KgTUh3KLijVluDvNpzDCJJfrJ7EyLzYLmdHCksG4sRg='
	option route_allowed_ips '1'
	list allowed_ips '0.0.0.0/0'
